title: MIFLOW: Dynamic Recent-Behavior Priors for Reference-Calibrated Online Flow-Policy Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31902v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-based policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. In online actor-critic learning, off-policy value estimates can be unreliable in poorly covered action regions, where expressive policies may shift probability mass toward critic-favored actions. We propose MIFLOW, which calibrates online flow-policy learning with a recency-adaptive flow-matching prior fitted to recently executed actions. Inspired by canalization as a qualitative analogy for path-dependent stabilization, we use the prior as a moving density reference for value-guided policy improvement. MIFLOW uses the approximate recent-action log-density in a dimension-normalized correction to both actor updates and critic targets. This correction increases the cost of low-density actions while keeping them available. Across six MuJoCo continuous-control tasks and five random seeds, MIFLOW achieves competitive mean return curves

translated_title: MIFLOW：用于参考校准在线流策略强化学习的动态近期行为先验
translated_abstract: 基于流的策略为连续控制强化学习提供了富有表现力的动作分布。在在线演员-评论家（actor-critic）学习中，当动作覆盖不足时，离策略价值估计可能不可靠，此时富有表现力的策略可能会将概率质量转移到评论家偏好的动作上。我们提出MIFLOW，该方法通过一个与最近执行动作拟合的、随时间自适应更新的流匹配先验来校准在线流策略学习。受“渠化”（canalization）概念作为路径依赖稳定化的定性类比启发，我们将该先验用作价值引导策略改进的移动密度参考。MIFLOW在演员更新和评论家目标中均采用近似近期动作对数密度进行维度归一化校正。这种校正提高了低密度动作的成本，同时保持这些动作仍然可用。在六个MuJoCo连续控制任务和五个随机种子上，MIFLOW取得了具有竞争力的平均回报曲线。
tldr: MIFLOW通过用拟合最近执行动作的动态流匹配先验作为移动密度参考，对在线流策略强化学习的演员更新和评论家目标进行维度归一化校正，在抑制低密度不可靠动作的同时保持探索能力，从而在MuJoCo连续控制任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
en_tdlr: MIFLOW calibrates online flow-policy reinforcement learning by using a recency-adaptive flow-matching prior fitted to recently executed actions as a moving density reference, applying dimension-normalized corrections to both actor updates and critic targets to increase the cost of low-density actions while keeping them available, achieving competitive performance across MuJoCo continuous-control tasks.
